coverage_basis: Meaningful developments since the 2026-09-09 edition, with same-day re-discovery and continuity checks.

mandatory_source_sweep.no_material_update_note: Mandatory sources without a qualifying new development were still treated as checked coverage inputs rather than publication quotas.

access_notes: Some journalism pages were paywalled or robots-limited in direct retrieval; no material claim was promoted solely from an inaccessible source.
Primary/original sources were preferred for product architecture, vendor protocols and research papers.

items: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash new-architecture claim; insufficient primary technical detail for architecture analysis

candidates.title: Visa, Mastercard and Ant International coordinate Know-Your-Agent trust framework
HBM scarcity raises Chinese AI-accelerator prices
Anthropic fourth cyber incident and 481M transcript rescan
Red Hat AI 3.5 safety/observability platform release
Google Finland investment and Fortum nuclear PPA
candidates.reason: Already fully represented in the earlier same-day edition and story memory; newer same-day signals improved the rebuilt issue's marginal information value.

candidates.title: NVIDIA Australia up-to-2GW DSX buildout
candidates.reason: Retained in storyline memory but displaced from the rerun by fresher same-day model, HBM and trust-layer developments.

rejected_stories.title: BIS financial-stability warnings around AI investment
rejected_stories.reason: Material macro context but lower direct builder relevance; exact same-day primary speech/quantitative source was not sufficiently surfaced for the brief's evidence bar.

rejected_stories.title: Reported DOJ scrutiny of NVIDIA-Groq transaction structure
rejected_stories.reason: Second-order reported antitrust development with weaker immediate engineering relevance than higher-ranked candidates.

rejected_stories.title: AI extinction/doom forecasts from individual researchers
rejected_stories.reason: Forecast/opinion content with insufficient decision-grade evidence for a high-signal daily story.

rejected_stories.title: Production trading-agent observational paper
rejected_stories.reason: Interesting contrarian evidence but domain-specific and not strong enough versus today's two higher-priority research items.

rejected_stories.title: Community DeepSeek benchmark/speed tables
rejected_stories.reason: Excluded from claims and publication because stable primary documentation and independent reproducible evidence were not available.

contrarian_evidence.narrative: Agentic commerce is ready for broad consumer adoption
contrarian_evidence.counter: Visa's own vendor-sponsored Trust Index reports only 23% of U.S. respondents trust GenAI to handle payment transactions.
contrarian_evidence.disposition: Used as adoption caveat; does not negate protocol progress.

contrarian_evidence.counter: No decision-grade model card/independent task evaluation surfaced; community benchmark values excluded.
contrarian_evidence.disposition: Performance remains Vendor claim; recommend internal eval only.

contrarian_evidence.narrative: NVIDIA EPD implies universal 5x/7x multimodal gains
contrarian_evidence.counter: NVIDIA itself says gains shrink for decode-heavy traffic and large dense models.
contrarian_evidence.disposition: Vendor benchmark clearly labeled and applicability bounded.

contrarian_evidence.narrative: China's domestic accelerator push solves compute independence cheaply
contrarian_evidence.counter: Reported HBM shortages and gray-market costs raise accelerator prices materially.

emerging_signals.thesis: Agent identity, delegated authority, credentials and audit are moving outside models into external control planes.
emerging_signals.falsifier: Protocols remain isolated pilots and major platforms do not expose enforceable delegation/policy primitives.

emerging_signals.thesis: Multimodal serving is beginning to split media encoding into its own independently scheduled resource tier.
emerging_signals.falsifier: Independent workloads show transfer/scheduling overhead erases gains or adoption remains vendor-specific.

house_evals.reason: No new model/runtime could be tested in this run with a pinned, reproducible external environment and fair baseline. Policy explicitly forbids benchmark theater; the decision was therefore to skip rather than fabricate a weak comparison.

source_diversity_sanity_check.finding: Reuters was the strongest same-day breaking-news discovery source, but material technical interpretation was triangulated with primary/original sources from Anthropic, NVIDIA, Red Hat, Visa, Mastercard and arXiv. No source received a ranking bonus for prominence.

watchlist.reason: Strong primary enterprise-platform contribution in this run; one observation is insufficient for mandatory/catalog promotion under policy.

visuals.notes: One original Concept-of-the-Day architecture diagram; no stock imagery or unverified hotlinks.

findings.finding: DeepSeek community benchmark/speed numbers were not supported by stable primary technical documentation or independent reproduction.
findings.resolution: Removed all such numbers; release labeled Reported and performance claims Vendor claim.

findings.finding: Chinese accelerator price figures rely in part on anonymous industry sources.
findings.resolution: Kept only Reuters-attributed ranges and labeled story Reported; no manufacturer-confirmed pricing claim.

findings.finding: NVIDIA 5x/7x EPD results are vendor benchmarks and could be overgeneralized.
findings.resolution: Explicit Vendor benchmark language added with decode-heavy/dense-model limitations from the same source.

findings.finding: Know-Your-Agent coordination could be mistaken for a finished universal standard.
findings.resolution: Language narrowed to joint initiative/convergence; adoption/standardization uncertainty and Visa trust counterevidence added.

findings.finding: MemSentry synthetic results and MOLE benchmark design could be read as production validation.
findings.resolution: Both labeled Early signal with explicit replication/production-transfer limitations.

findings.finding: Same-day rerun risked repeating Google/NVIDIA infrastructure stories without adding information.
findings.resolution: Those stories remain in memory but were displaced from the rebuilt issue by fresher same-day signals.

findings.finding: No third-party visual provenance to audit.
findings.resolution: Only an original architecture diagram is used.
